o.text: Ultimately from Proto-Turkic *čï̄pïn. Cognate with Turkish cibin, Crimean Tatar çibin, Turkmen çybyn, Bashkir себен (sibin), Kazakh шыбын (šıbın, “šïbïn”), Kyrgyz чымын (cımın, “čïmïn”), Southern Altai чымын (čïmïn), Karachay-Balkar, чибин (cibin, “čibin”), Uzbek chivin.
From Arabic قالب (qālib), ultimately from Ancient Greek καλοπόδιον (kalopódion).
